note: Station 1, the Lake of the Tiers (PLAN.md sections 9 and 10a: the upper lake's north shore, centred on the drawn shore at 5.1 px 1262,513.4). kin: the eastern badlands' Fremont cottonwood (where the seep reaches the shore), Utah juniper and pinyon (the Black Step's dry tread), read in place (PLAN.md section 4, 'Read in place').
